title: New Lunaris Series - Bold Italian Design
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the Moon

Lunaris draws its design influence from the graceful dance of the moon, offering bold statement pieces to elevate your wash area.

Whether used as a bench top, vanity top, or wall-hung basin, Lunaris captivates with its distinctive form and aesthetic.

Discover the Lunaris Series

Towel Rails add functionality in Wall Hung Installations

The Lunaris Mirror

The Lunaris Mirror pairs perfectly with the Lunaris Series Basins and Towel Rails, featuring two satellite mirrors that 'orbit' the main mirror, allowing for adjustable placement options depending on your preference.

One satellite mirror emits natural LED light, while the other is a zoom mirror, offering a complete and beautiful mirror solution.

Lunaris Mirror Available in Matte Black and Matte White

Apartment 35 Round - 350 x 130 mm

Lunaris Towel Rails

Crafted especially for the Lunaris basin series, these sleek towel rails for wall-mounted installations, offer space saving functionality and a complete aesthetic when paired with the Lunaris Mirror. Available in both Matte Black and Matte White.
